title: Ashbury Rewards Earning Schedule: Base Points by Brand and Elite Bonus by Tier
content:
Ashbury Rewards base points are earned per US dollar of eligible spend at a rate set by the brand of the hotel. The elite bonus is a percentage set by the member's tier, and it is applied to base points. Fractional points are always rounded down to a whole point.

## Base points per US dollar of eligible spend

The brand rate is the same at every tier.

| Hotel brand | Ashbury Rewards Member | Silver Elite | Gold Elite | Platinum Elite | Titanium Elite | Ambassador Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Ashbury Hotel | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Ashbury Grand | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Ashbury Reserve | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Elite bonus percentage, treatment of fractions and bonus basis

| | Ashbury Rewards Member | Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Elite bonus, as a percentage of the base points of a stay | 0% | 10% | 25% | 50% | 75% | 75% |
| What the elite bonus percentage is applied to | base points | base points | base points | base points | base points | base points |
| Fractional points | rounded down to a whole point | rounded down to a whole point | rounded down to a whole point | rounded down to a whole point | rounded down to a whole point | rounded down to a whole point |

Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite and Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite share the same elite bonus percentage, 75%. A tier with an elite bonus percentage of 0% earns no elite bonus.

## Worked figure (hypothetical spend)

| Hypothetical eligible spend | Brand | Rate | Product | Base points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 412.37 USD | Ashbury Grand | 10 per USD | 4123.7 | 4123 (rounded down) |
| 89.90 USD | Ashbury Express | 5 per USD | 449.5 | 449 (rounded down) |
